sources.entry: hatch - Modern, extensible Python project manager for environments, builds, and publishing.

summary.one_liner: Hatch is a modern, extensible Python project manager covering environments, builds, testing, and publishing to PyPI or other indices.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Hatch as a modern, extensible Python project manager. It lists features including a standardized build system with reproducible builds, environment management with support for custom scripts and UV, and configurable Python distribution management. It also covers test execution, static analysis with default settings, a built-in Python script runner, and publishing to PyPI or other indices. Additional features are version management and project generation. The README claims the CLI is about 2-3x faster than equivalent tools, without giving benchmark details. The README points to a separate Why Hatch? page and documentation hosted on GitHub Pages.
use_cases: run tests and static analysis on a Python project
notable: Standardized, reproducible build system by default
Environment management with custom scripts and UV support
caveats: README gives no install or run instructions; see the external documentation
Speed claim of ~2-3x faster is not backed by details in the README
